what: Claimed amount divided by the median for similar claims (same cover, region and loss type)
motivation: Inflated claims stand out against what similar losses usually cost
if_higher: Above 2.5: far more than similar losses cost

what: Days between the policy start date and the date of loss
motivation: A loss right after buying cover suggests it was planned
if_lower: Under 30 days: the loss came almost immediately after cover started

what: Days between the loss and the first report
catches: weak context; staged or inflated claims
motivation: Long delays make losses hard to verify
if_higher: Weeks: a late report, harder to verify

what: Claims by the same policyholder in the last 3 years
Other open claims that share a driver, passenger, witness or phone number with this claim
motivation: Organised rings reuse the same people across staged accidents
if_higher: 1 or more: people linked to other claims

what: 1 if the claimed injury is soft-tissue only (for example whiplash)
motivation: Soft-tissue injuries are hard to disprove, so rings favour them
if_lower: 0: no injury or a verifiable one

what: 1 if a police report was filed
if_lower: 0: no police report; harder to verify

what: Share of this repair shop's past claims that were flagged as suspicious
motivation: Some shops inflate repair bills systematically
if_higher: Above 0.2: a shop with a history of flagged claims
